integrity: Proof derives an exact quadratic determinant and all endpoint/interior regular multiplicities. Symbolic identities and direct sample regular matrices reproduce the claimed levels; no finite sample is treated as a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact four-point supports with a three-term progression in the abelian coset and one reflection; arbitrary nonzero complex coefficients. Does not classify other supports, conditioning, or finite-field ranks. Historical priority remains subject to independent review.
title: Five arithmetic nullity strata for four-tap convolution on generalized dihedral groups
